svg.title: Coffee Digital bean mark
svg.desc: A single 'e' bean. Reconstructed from creds/logo.jpeg by measurement, not tracing. Measured: ring outer width 392px, bar width 403px, total height 443px, stroke 32px, cut line at 46.5% of height, lower arc terminating 16 degrees below the horizontal. Normalised to height 100. Colour is inherited via currentColor.
